subject.title: build(deps): bump the actions group across 1 directory with 14 updates

question: Should the workflow and secops owners approve these 14 pinned action revisions for the token, scanning, publishing, automation, and Codex-agent boundaries after a current-main rebase and green exact-head checks?
rationale: Dependabot can refresh immutable pins, but it cannot own the repository's trust decision for new third-party code executing with secrets and write-capable permissions; CODEOWNERS and the protected security label reserve that decision for humans.

options.title: Refresh and approve the batch
options.body: Rebase onto current main, require the exact-head security and workflow gates to pass, then approve all revisions as one coordinated dependency update.

options.title: Split privileged revisions
options.body: Separate token, Docker publishing, CodeQL, and Codex-action changes into smaller PRs if owners cannot confidently review the combined trust surface.

options.title: Defer the update
options.body: Leave the existing pins in place and close or regenerate the batch later if any upstream revision remains unacceptable or unverifiable.

recommendation.title: Refresh and approve the batch
recommendation.body: Rebase onto current main, require the exact-head security and workflow gates to pass, then approve all revisions as one coordinated dependency update.

likelyOwner.reason: This handle has the strongest cross-workflow history, owns much of the Codex-agent workflow lifecycle, and is already connected to the live PR discussion.
